svg.title: C14-M02-F3: The hash-chained collection log
svg.desc: Two log entries, the second containing the hash of the first, and a note showing that editing the first breaks verification.
svg.text: entry 1: {file, url, SIR-1.1, sha256, prev=000..0} -> entry_sha256 = H1
entry 2: {file, url, PIR-1, sha256, prev=H1} -> entry_sha256 = H2
edit entry 1 -> recomputed hash != H1 -> "TAMPERED OR OUT OF ORDER"
Figure C14-M02-F3. Each entry commits to its predecessor.
